_comment: Incident-tuned trail-filter denylists (Epic 025). Compiled with re.I. See tests/test_trail_filter.py for the pinned behavior. `residential_street_suffix` lists the full USPS residential street-type set; `circle|place|terrace` were added for the dogfood-#2 class — TIGER-imported cul-de-sacs (Oak Circle, Peace and Quiet Circle, Wildwood Place; tiger:name_type Cir/Pl/Ter) that carry no numbered ref and so cleared every other gate. Deliberately still excludes `road` (real fire/dike roads end in Road). `name_deny`'s comfort-station/showers/unnamed/new-placeholder/access-route/numbered-ramp tokens (2026-07) close the GLM corpus-quality-sweep OBX/York-River gap (docs/research/glm-corpus-quality-sweep-2026-07.md, F1-F4) — verified + narrowed vs. the raw proposal: `showers` widened from `showers? path` (missed word-order variant 'Path Loop B Showers') to a bare `showers`/`shower path` pair so both orders match, while singular geographic-feature names ('Shower Creek Falls Trail') still survive; `unnamed` narrowed from a bare `\bunnamed\b` (would drop the real-world 'Unnamed Creek Trail' naming convention) to `unnamed (trail|path|shortcut|section|way)` so it only fires on OSM-editor placeholder names, not a locally-unnamed geographic feature.
